# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Kit refill notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], upper level, two minutes from the transit platform. Dry wall, own locker, kit station at the end of the corridor. Quiet tenant, off-shift sleeper preferred. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]SHORING CREW WANTED[/bold] for the new face on the deep level. Must keep a mask on the belt and a cool head when the meter ticks. - [bold]TRACK WALKERS[/bold] needed for off-shift line inspections. Lamp and boots provided. Bring your own patience. - [bold]GENERATOR HAND[/bold] sought for the thermal plant at the powerstation. Some mechanical training. Must not mind the noise or the heat.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]HELMET LAMPS[/bold], rebuilt with fresh cells. Ten credits each, or trade for mask filters. - [bold]GAS METER[/bold], bench tested, reads true. Will not sell it to anyone who plans to switch off the alarm.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: a brass lighter with an engraving on the side, somewhere between the mess hall and the platform. It was my father's. Reward. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: one work glove, left hand, on the mountain road up to the landing zone. Claim it at the press office.
## Notices - To the crew on the lower platform using a stack of emergency oxygen kits as a card table: those are for breathing. Put them back on the wall.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
